scope: Map Data persisted search count/page generation consistency

referenceArtifact.use: identity check only; original map_search transaction mode was not inferred

policy.statement: one map_search response must derive its total and rows from one SQLite read snapshot
policy.rationale: the store instance lock cannot prevent another SQLite connection from publishing between separate count and page reads

behavior: begin one deferred SQLite transaction before count
assign the transaction to count and page commands
commit the read transaction after page materialization

reproduction.scenario: two initial city rows; second MapDataStore connection commits a third row after count and before page
reproduction.expected: in-flight result total=2 and rows=2 without the third row; post-search database count=3

limits: not recovered original LWBridge transaction semantics
advanced query predicates/sorts remain separately gated
map_data_options, authoritative summary state, export and native record-key derivation remain open

implementationImpact.featureLedger: M07 remains partial; existing supported query subset now has consistent count/page generation semantics
